# MosoFin Finance Skill Explainers
> Public, source-linked guides explain accounting workflows and the finance skills that support them.

This site explains finance workflows for business owners, bookkeepers, and finance automation reviewers. It is an educational guide site; the pages do not install or run accounting skills.

## Start here

- [Finance Workflow Guides | MosoFin-Skill-Explainer](https://skills.mosofin.com/): Explore MosoFin finance workflow guides: bank reconciliation, cash forecasts, invoice checks, and payment matching, with cited examples and practical steps.

## Skill guides

- [Accruals and deferrals: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/accruals-and-deferrals/): Puts each cost and each income item in the month it belongs to: accrues what was used but not yet billed, defers what was paid in advance, and checks last…
- [AP accrual cutoff: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/ap-accrual-cutoff/): Finds goods received and work done with no bill yet at month end, drafts the accrual and its reversal, and keeps open orders out.
- [AP aging and payment runs: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/ap-aging-and-payment-runs/): Sorts every unpaid bill by how late it is, finds discounts worth taking, and proposes who to pay this week with the cash you choose to spend.
- [AR aging and collections: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/ar-aging-and-collections/): Sorts every unpaid customer invoice by how late it is, ties the aging to your books, ranks who to chase first, works out DSO on credit sales and drafts…
- [Balance sheet reconciliations: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/balance-sheet-reconciliations/): Proves each balance sheet account against outside support, types every difference, gives it an owner and an age, and shows coverage on one sheet.
- [Bank reconciliation: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/bank-reconciliation/): Proves your bank statement and your books differ only for reasons you can name (timing, fees, bounced items) and finds what is left over.
- [Budget vs actual analysis: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/budget-vs-actual-analysis/): Compares each line of your month to a named budget, labels every gap good or bad, splits big gaps into causes, and drafts the explanation with an owner.
- [Cash application: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/cash-application/): Matches each customer payment to the invoices it settles, explains every short or over payment, and parks what it cannot match instead of guessing.
- [13-week cash flow forecast: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/cash-flow-forecast-13-week/): Projects cash in and cash out week by week for 13 weeks, times receipts by how late each customer really pays, and finds the lowest point, the runway and the…
- [Closing entries and trial balance: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/closing-entries-and-trial-balance/): Closes the year's income and expenses into owners' equity, tests that the platform has not closed it already, and proves the post-closing trial balance.
- [Credit card reconciliation: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/credit-card-reconciliation/): Ties the company card statement to your books, matches receipts to charges, and lists what is missing, personal, duplicated or in the wrong account.
- [Credit memos and refunds: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/credit-memo-and-refund-handler/): Checks each credit memo, refund, vendor credit or chargeback against the original invoice, keeps the tax on its own line, and proposes the entry for a person…
- [Customer invoicing: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/customer-invoicing/): Prepares invoices with every field your tax rules require, and checks the ones you already sent for missing fields, wrong totals and gaps in the numbers.
- [Duplicate invoice detection: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/duplicate-invoice-detection/): Scans your bills and payments for the same bill entered or paid twice, a supplier under two records, and credit notes nobody used, and lists the unpaid…
- [Expense report processing: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/expense-report-processor/): Reviews staff expense claims against your own policy, codes each line to your accounts, and catches a claim for something the company card already paid.
- [Financial statement builder: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/financial-statement-builder/): Builds the income statement, balance sheet, cash flow and equity statement from your trial balance, and proves they tie to each other before anyone sees them.
- [Fixed assets and depreciation: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/fixed-asset-register-and-depreciation/): Ties the asset register to the books, works out this month's book depreciation from your policy, finds disposals booked wrong, and leaves tax depreciation to…
- [GL coding assistant: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/gl-coding-assistant/): Suggests a ledger account for each uncoded transaction from your own chart and history, rates its confidence, flags what a person must review, and posts…
- [Inventory to GL reconciliation: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/inventory-to-gl-reconciliation/): Compares the inventory account, the stock records and a physical count, explains each difference, and proposes adjustments for a person to post.
- [Invoice data extractor: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/invoice-data-extractor/): Reads supplier bills into fields as printed, checks each against the books, and stops a duplicate or already paid bill before anyone pays it.
- [Journal entry builder: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/journal-entry-builder/): Builds a balanced journal entry from your books, checks it 15 ways before anyone posts it, and never posts it itself.
- [Journal entry review: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/journal-entry-review/): Reads every entry in a period, scores the manual ones against risk indicators, says which tests it could not run, and changes nothing in the books.
- [Payment processor reconciliation: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/merchant-and-payment-processor-rec/): Checks that what Stripe, Square or PayPal says you were paid matches your books, and catches revenue recorded net of processor fees.
- [Month-end close checklist: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/month-end-close-checklist/): Builds your close task list by day, fits it to your business, fills each task's status from what the books show, and checks the month opens where the last one…
- [Payroll clearing reconciliation: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/payroll-clearing-reconciliation/): Finds what is stuck in the payroll clearing account and why, tests each payroll liability for the balance it should carry, and proposes entries for a person…
- [Payroll journal entry builder: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/payroll-journal-entry-builder/): Turns a payroll register into balanced journal entries for wages, withholdings and employer costs, splits them by department, and posts nothing.
- [Payroll reconciliation: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/payroll-reconciliation/): Ties what payroll says you paid to the bank, the books and the tax filings, and flags a tax deposit that is late or a liability that does not carry forward.
- [Prepaid amortization schedule: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/prepaid-amortization-schedule/): Spreads a prepaid cost such as a year of insurance over the months it covers, ties the account to the schedule, and finds missed runs and stray items.
- [Recurring transaction builder: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/recurring-transaction-builder/): Builds a dated schedule for a bill or entry that repeats, rolls dates off weekends and holidays, finds duplicate templates, and checks each run happened.
- [Three-way match: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/three-way-match/): Checks that what you ordered, what arrived and what the supplier billed agree, line by line, before anything is paid, and says which of the three it had.
- [Vendor statement reconciliation: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/vendor-statement-reconciliation/): Ties a supplier's own statement to your accounts payable, item by item, to find invoices your books never saw and credit notes nobody claimed.
- [Multi-entity forecast dashboard: guides and examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/multi-entity-forecast-dashboard/): Adds several company files month by month into one cash dashboard, shows money owed inside the group, and projects six months under three scenarios.

## Plain-language guides

- [Accruals and Deferrals in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/accruals-and-deferrals/plain.html): How month-end accruals and deferrals put costs and income in the month they happened, and the missed reversal the skill catches. Facts cited.
- [AP Accrual Cutoff in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/ap-accrual-cutoff/plain.html): How a month-end AP accrual puts goods received and work done without a bill into the right month, and keeps open orders out. Facts cited.
- [AP Aging and Payment Runs in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/ap-aging-and-payment-runs/plain.html): What an AP aging and payment run shows: how late each bill is, who to pay first with the cash you choose to spend, and what waits. Facts cited.
- [AR Aging and Collections in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/ar-aging-and-collections/plain.html): What an AR aging shows: who owes you money, how late each invoice is, who to chase first, and who gets no reminder. Facts cited.
- [Balance Sheet Reconciliations in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/balance-sheet-reconciliations/plain.html): How a balance sheet reconciliation proves each account: two sides, typed differences, owners, ages and a coverage sheet. Facts cited.
- [Bank Reconciliation Explained in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/bank-reconciliation/plain.html): What a bank reconciliation checks, why your books and bank statement differ, and the mistake it catches. Explained in plain English, with every fact cited.
- [Budget vs Actual Analysis in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/budget-vs-actual-analysis/plain.html): What a budget vs actual review shows: the gap on every line, which gaps need words, why each one happened, and who owns it. Worked example, facts cited.
- [Cash Application Explained in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/cash-application/plain.html): How cash application matches each customer payment to the invoices it pays, explains every short pay, and drafts an entry for you to post. Facts cited.
- [13-Week Cash Flow Forecast in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/cash-flow-forecast-13-week/plain.html): What a 13-week cash flow forecast shows: cash in and out each week, the lowest point, the week that breaks your floor, and whether you make payroll.
- [Closing Entries and Trial Balance in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/closing-entries-and-trial-balance/plain.html): How a year-end close moves profit into owners' equity, tests for a double close, and proves that the books still balance. Facts cited.
- [Credit Card Reconciliation Explained in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/credit-card-reconciliation/plain.html): What a corporate card reconciliation checks: the statement tied to your books, receipts matched, and the charges that hide in a total. Facts cited.
- [Credit Memos and Refunds in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/credit-memo-and-refund-handler/plain.html): How a credit memo, refund, vendor credit or chargeback goes into the books: checked against the original invoice, with the tax on its own line.
- [Customer Invoicing Explained in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/customer-invoicing/plain.html): What a complete customer invoice must show, how the skill prepares one and checks the ones you sent: fields, sums, prices and number gaps. Facts cited.
- [Duplicate Invoice Detection in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/duplicate-invoice-detection/plain.html): What a duplicate invoice scan checks: your bills and payments for the same bill entered or paid twice, a supplier under two records, and unused credits.
- [Expense Report Processing in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/expense-report-processor/plain.html): What an expense report review checks: each claim against your policy, a claim the company card already paid, and what each employee is owed. Facts cited.
- [Financial Statements Explained in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/financial-statement-builder/plain.html): How a trial balance becomes a balance sheet, income statement and cash flow, the seven checks that prove they agree, and what your bank can still ask for.
- [Fixed Asset Register and Depreciation in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/fixed-asset-register-and-depreciation/plain.html): What you own, its book value and this month's depreciation, with tax kept apart, and the errors a fixed asset register run catches. Facts cited.
- [GL Coding Explained in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/gl-coding-assistant/plain.html): How a GL coding assistant suggests an account for each transaction from your own chart and history, flags what a person must review, and posts nothing.
- [Inventory to GL Reconciliation in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/inventory-to-gl-reconciliation/plain.html): How an inventory reconciliation compares the books, the stock system and a physical count, then explains each difference. Facts cited.
- [Invoice Data Extractor in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/invoice-data-extractor/plain.html): How the invoice data extractor reads supplier bills into fields and stops a duplicate or paid bill before payment. Sources cited.
- [Journal Entry Builder in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/journal-entry-builder/plain.html): How a journal entry gets checked before anyone posts it: it balances, uses real accounts, has a memo and a source, and carries review flags. Facts cited.
- [Journal Entry Review in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/journal-entry-review/plain.html): How a read-only screen reads every entry in a quarter, scores the ones typed in by hand, and lists the tests it could not run. Facts cited.
- [Payment Processor Reconciliation in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/merchant-and-payment-processor-rec/plain.html): Does Stripe, Square or PayPal match your books? What a payment processor reconciliation checks, and the common mistake of booking sales net of fees.
- [Month-End Close Checklist in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/month-end-close-checklist/plain.html): What a month-end close checklist shows: which tasks apply to your business, what the books prove is done, and if this month starts where last ended.
- [Payroll Clearing Reconciliation in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/payroll-clearing-reconciliation/plain.html): Why a payroll clearing account does not return to zero, how the skill ages what is stuck in it, and why unclaimed pay is never written off.
- [Payroll Journal Entries Explained in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/payroll-journal-entry-builder/plain.html): How payroll journal entries split gross pay, withholdings, net pay and employer costs, and why an entry that balances can still be wrong.
- [Payroll Reconciliation Explained in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/payroll-reconciliation/plain.html): How payroll reconciliation ties the payroll register to the books, the bank and the tax filings, and why a balanced account can hide a late tax deposit.
- [Prepaid Expense Amortization in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/prepaid-amortization-schedule/plain.html): How a prepaid cost such as a year of insurance goes into each month, and the missed run and stray items the skill finds. Facts cited.
- [Recurring Bills and Entries in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/recurring-transaction-builder/plain.html): What a recurring schedule shows: every date and amount, holiday rolls, a duplicate template, and a monthly check that each bill ran. Facts cited.
- [Three-Way Match Explained: Pay, Hold or Reject | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/three-way-match/plain.html): How a three-way match compares the purchase order, goods receipt and invoice before you pay: what it catches, what it asks, what it never does. Sources cited.
- [Vendor Statement Reconciliation in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/vendor-statement-reconciliation/plain.html): What a vendor statement reconciliation checks: a supplier's statement against your accounts payable, to find missing invoices and unclaimed credits.
- [Multi-Entity Cash Forecast in Plain English | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/multi-entity-forecast-dashboard/plain.html): How a group cash dashboard adds company files month by month, shows money owed inside the group, and projects six months. Facts cited.

## Step-by-step guides

- [Accruals and Deferrals Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/accruals-and-deferrals/learn.html): Six worked accrual and deferral examples, from one electricity bill to a missed reversal, with a calculator for accruals, deferrals and roll-forwards.
- [AP Accrual Cutoff Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/ap-accrual-cutoff/learn.html): Six worked AP accrual examples, from one delivery with no bill to small items that add up, with an accrual calculator. Rules quoted, facts cited.
- [AP Aging and Payment Run Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/ap-aging-and-payment-runs/learn.html): Six worked AP aging examples, from one late bill to a payment run that fits the cash you choose to spend, with a run calculator. Rules quoted, facts cited.
- [AR Aging and Collections Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/ar-aging-and-collections/learn.html): Six worked AR aging examples, from one late invoice to the customers you chase first, with an aging and DSO calculator. Rules quoted, facts cited.
- [Balance Sheet Reconciliation Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/balance-sheet-reconciliations/learn.html): Six worked balance sheet reconciliation levels, from one account with two sides to a coverage sheet, with a one-account calculator. Rules quoted, facts cited.
- [Bank Reconciliation Worked Examples, Step by Step | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/bank-reconciliation/learn.html): Seven worked bank reconciliation examples, from one uncashed cheque to two companies sharing an account, with a calculator and cited sources.
- [Budget vs Actual Variance Analysis Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/budget-vs-actual-analysis/learn.html): Six worked budget vs actual examples, from one marketing line to commentary with an owner, with a variance calculator. Rules quoted, facts cited.
- [Cash Application Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/cash-application/learn.html): Six worked cash application examples, from one payment by reference to short pays and the tie-out, with a short-pay calculator. Rules quoted, facts cited.
- [13-Week Cash Flow Forecast Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/cash-flow-forecast-13-week/learn.html): Six worked cash forecast examples, from one week's chain to the week that breaks a covenant floor, with a 13-week calculator. Rules quoted, facts cited.
- [Closing Entries and Trial Balance Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/closing-entries-and-trial-balance/learn.html): Six worked year-end close levels for a two-member LLC, from one account type to the double-close test, with a closing calculator. Rules quoted, facts cited.
- [Credit Card Reconciliation Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/credit-card-reconciliation/learn.html): Seven worked corporate-card examples, from a statement that ties to a card paying another company's bills, with a calculator. Rules quoted, facts cited.
- [Credit Memo and Refund Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/credit-memo-and-refund-handler/learn.html): Six worked credit memo examples, from one pricing credit to chargebacks and bad debts, with a calculator that checks one credit. Rules quoted, facts cited.
- [Customer Invoicing Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/customer-invoicing/learn.html): Six worked customer invoicing examples, from the fields a valid invoice needs to gaps in the number sequence, with a checker. Rules quoted, facts cited.
- [Duplicate Invoice Detection Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/duplicate-invoice-detection/learn.html): Six worked duplicate-bill examples, from one invoice number entered twice to the fraud test the scan cannot run, with a calculator. Rules quoted, facts cited.
- [Expense Report Processing Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/expense-report-processor/learn.html): Six worked expense report examples, from one taxi with no receipt to the ledger checks, with a reimbursement calculator. Rules quoted, facts cited.
- [Financial Statement Builder Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/financial-statement-builder/learn.html): Six worked levels that turn a trial balance into five financial statements and prove seven tie-outs, with a tie-out calculator. Rules quoted, facts cited.
- [Fixed Asset Depreciation Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/fixed-asset-register-and-depreciation/learn.html): Six worked fixed asset examples, from one machine's monthly book depreciation to a register that ties both ways, with a calculator. Rules quoted, facts cited.
- [GL Coding Assistant Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/gl-coding-assistant/learn.html): Six worked GL coding examples, from one clean vendor match to a payout that is not income, with a confidence and flag calculator. Rules quoted, facts cited.
- [Inventory to GL Reconciliation Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/inventory-to-gl-reconciliation/learn.html): Six worked inventory reconciliation examples, from one counted item to the reserve and write-down, with a count variance calculator. Rules quoted, facts cited.
- [Invoice Data Extraction Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/invoice-data-extractor/learn.html): Six worked invoice extraction examples, from one supplier bill into fields to a batch of 12, with an invoice check calculator. Rules quoted, facts cited.
- [Journal Entry Builder Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/journal-entry-builder/learn.html): Six worked journal entry examples, from one balanced accrual to a batch with 15 checks on each entry, with an entry checker. Rules quoted, facts cited.
- [Journal Entry Review Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/journal-entry-review/learn.html): Six worked levels of a journal entry review, from 1,284 transactions to one warranty-reserve pattern, with an entry scorer. Rules quoted, facts cited.
- [Stripe, Square and PayPal Reconciliation Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/merchant-and-payment-processor-rec/learn.html): Seven worked examples, from one $100 sale to Stripe, Square and PayPal feeding one bank account, with a calculator. Every rule quoted, every fact cited.
- [Month-End Close Checklist Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/month-end-close-checklist/learn.html): Six worked month-end close examples, from a list scoped to one business to the continuity tie-out, with a continuity calculator. Rules quoted, facts cited.
- [Payroll Clearing Reconciliation Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/payroll-clearing-reconciliation/learn.html): Six worked levels on a payroll clearing account that never returns to nil: ageing, stale items, a nil that hides a missed deposit, and a calculator.
- [Payroll Journal Entries Worked Step by Step | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/payroll-journal-entry-builder/learn.html): Six worked levels on one payroll run: three amounts, two entries tied to the register, the department split, the accrual estimate and a calculator.
- [Payroll Reconciliation Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/payroll-reconciliation/learn.html): Six worked payroll reconciliation levels, from one quarter's register to the exceptions you fix first, with a tie-out calculator. Rules quoted, facts cited.
- [Prepaid Amortization Schedule Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/prepaid-amortization-schedule/learn.html): Six worked prepaid amortization examples, from one insurance policy to a three-way tie-out, with a schedule calculator. Rules quoted, facts cited.
- [Recurring Schedule Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/recurring-transaction-builder/learn.html): Six worked levels for a recurring rent schedule: holiday rolls, a 3% step, a duplicate template and a run audit, with a schedule calculator.
- [Three-Way Match Worked Examples and Calculator | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/three-way-match/learn.html): Seven worked three-way match examples, from a perfect match to a month of invoices, with a pay-or-dispute calculator. Every rule quoted, every fact cited.
- [Vendor Statement Reconciliation Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/vendor-statement-reconciliation/learn.html): Six worked supplier-statement examples, from one invoice number spelled two ways to a payment sent elsewhere, with a calculator. Rules quoted, facts cited.
- [Multi-Entity Cash Forecast Worked Examples | MosoFin](https://skills.mosofin.com/skills/multi-entity-forecast-dashboard/learn.html): Six worked levels for a multi-company cash forecast, from one month of cash flow to a six-month group projection, with a calculator. Rules quoted, facts cited.

## Topics

Published topics include bank reconciliation, cash flow forecasting, credit card reconciliation, duplicate invoice detection, payment processor reconciliation, three-way matching, and vendor statement reconciliation.
